name: seller.draft.unused
title: Profile: seller.draft.unused
description: Canonical profile for finding drafts that were not consumed by publish yet.
text:
# seller.draft.unused

TL;DR:
- Use usedAtIsNull=true to focus on drafts that are still available for publish.
- This pattern works for both count and collection.
whenToUse: When you want only drafts that remain unpublished.
When you want to count actionable draft work.
recommended: Combine with updatedAt desc for recent work.
avoid: Do not treat usedAt non-null drafts as editable publish candidates without extra checks.
exampleInterpretation: usedAt=null means the draft is still available for future publish.
